from collections import Counter
import compress
lines=open('corpus.txt','rb').read().splitlines()
positions=[]; lengths=Counter(); words=Counter()
for i,line in enumerate(lines):
 if line!=compress.expected_line(i)[:-1]:
  positions.append(i)
  prefix=b'%05d '%i; suffix=b' %d'%((i*7)%89); toks=line[len(prefix):len(line)-len(suffix)].split()
  lengths[len(toks)]+=1; words.update(toks)
print(len(positions), lengths, words)
print('flag entropy bits')
import math
n=6000;k=len(positions); p=k/n
print(n*(-p*math.log2(p)-(1-p)*math.log2(1-p)))
print('len entropy',sum(lengths.values()) and sum(-c*math.log2(c/sum(lengths.values())) for c in lengths.values()))
print('word entropy bits',sum(-c*math.log2(c/sum(words.values())) for c in words.values()), 'tokens',sum(words.values()))
